It was there that our philosophy took root: beauty isn’t just something you see—it’s something you feel. Today, that vision continues with The Skin Method. This new chapter refines what we’ve always stood for—pairing intention with innovation, precision with warmth. The Skin Method is about more than treatments; it’s about giving you the confidence to show up as your best self, every single day. To our clients, past and present: thank you. Your trust and support made Southern Maine Skin Company unforgettable—and now, you are the heart of The Skin Method. Our Values We built The Skin Method around one belief: that real results and real connection aren't opposites. Science guides our method. You inspire it. At The Skin Method, we believe in blending results with experience. Here’s what defines us: Client-Centered Care Every face is unique, and every treatment should be too. We customize each service so you leave feeling confident, radiant, and seen. Excellence & Quality We use advanced techniques and top-tier products to deliver results you can trust. Luxury doesn’t mean fussy—it means thoughtful, intentional care. Continuous Growth Skincare is always evolving, and so are we. From new technologies to refined techniques, we stay ahead so your skin always gets the best. Integrity & Trust Honest advice, genuine connections, and a commitment to doing what’s right for your skin—always. Holistic Beauty Glowing skin is only part of the story. We believe in a balance of inner wellness and outer radiance, creating results that feel as good as they look. Gratitude Our community is everything. We’re deeply thankful for every client who’s been part of our journey—and we never take your trust for granted. Meet the Founder I’ve always believed skincare is more than treatments—it’s confidence, connection, and the magic of feeling like your best self. When I first opened Southern Maine Skin Company, my dream was to create a boutique space where clinical precision and personal care came together. For nearly a decade, that vision grew into something so special: a community of clients who trusted us not just with their skin, but with their confidence. Now, with The Skin Method, that dream is evolving. This next chapter is about refinement, intention, and a little more edge—while still honoring the warmth and trust that built the foundation. Every service is designed to blend results with experience, giving your skin (and your spirit) the glow it deserves. To every client who has supported me on this journey—thank you.
